bridge_admissibility.CONSERVATIVE_EXTENSION: Adds comparison structure without excluding any old model after forgetting the new symbols.
bridge_admissibility.DEFINABLE_CONSEQUENCE: Constructed uniquely from frozen symbols by definability/quotient and natural under frozen isomorphisms.
bridge_admissibility.EXISTING_THEOREM: Already frozen in R052 and reused without mutation.
bridge_admissibility.ILLEGAL_OUTPUT_COPYING: An axiom or definition whose mathematical content is only that two final role outputs agree, or whose parameter is chosen from the desired classical identification.
bridge_admissibility.NONCONSERVATIVE_EXTENSION: Adds a real axiom restricting the old model class; must have an explicit mathematical reason and deletion/countermodel audit.
bridge_admissibility.NORMALIZATION_CHOICE: Breaks an independently exhibited scaling/unit automorphism or torsor; must be separately named.
bridge_admissibility.READOUT_SCALARIZATION: Adds N2/comparison output structure and may not be described as native equality.

classification_vocabulary.COMMON_REDUCT_POSSIBLE: Each role admits a frozen/definable forgetting construction into one common structural language; this does not identify the resulting objects.
classification_vocabulary.DEFINABLE_QUOTIENT_POSSIBLE: A comparison object is a quotient definable from frozen structure, with no arbitrary section, orientation, basepoint, metric, or scalar choice.
classification_vocabulary.FUNCTORIAL_REALIZATION_REQUIRED: Comparison is meaningful only after a functor/realization sends one or both frozen role objects into a common category/carrier.
classification_vocabulary.GROUP_EXTENSION_RELATION_REQUIRED: The relation is expressed through an exact group extension, quotient, kernel, lift, or doubling/squaring map rather than equality of final role outputs.
classification_vocabulary.ILL_TYPED_NO_COMMON_CARRIER: Direct equality is not a formula of the frozen combined language because the role terms have distinct carriers/codomains and no frozen comparison map.
classification_vocabulary.NORMALIZATION_REQUIRED: An otherwise legal scalar/readout construction has a nontrivial rescaling/unit torsor that must be fixed independently of the desired final equality.
classification_vocabulary.SAME_CODOMAIN_NATIVE_COMPARISON: Both frozen role terms inhabit the same frozen carrier/codomain in a common model, so equality is syntactically well-typed without adding a carrier identification.
classification_vocabulary.SCALARIZATION_REQUIRED: At least one frozen non-scalar object must be sent by a newly declared readout into a scalar codomain.

output_copying_test: Delete the proposed bridge axiom and ask whether it states independently meaningful structure. If its only surviving content is the desired final output equality, classify ILLEGAL_OUTPUT_COPYING.
pair_enumeration_rule: All 10 unordered pairs i<j in role_order; no omissions and no directional double counting.
primary_classification_rule: First ask whether direct equality is well-typed in the frozen common language.
If not, identify the least structural object needed merely to state a comparison.
Classify that object before asking whether any values coincide.
A pair may carry multiple required classes; ILL_TYPED_NO_COMMON_CARRIER remains explicit whenever native equality is not a formula.

semantic_discipline.foundational_logic: definitions are not inherited; no target-side object copied into bridge premises
semantic_discipline.gate_v3: carrier/type/readout strata are preserved; N2 scalarization is never silently promoted to N0
